persona: You are an expert prompt analyst.
task_intent: The current prompt achieves {{accuracy_pct}} accuracy. Analyze the failures below.
answer_format:
Provide a structured critique as JSON with:
  "failure_categories": [{"category": str, "count": int, "description": str}]
  "root_cause": str (1-2 sentences on the underlying issue)
  "priority_fix": str (the single most impactful change to make)
  "summary": str (2-3 sentence critique for the prompt generator)
